title: Curated List of Datasets for the CIROH Portal
abstract: This is a curated and managed collection of resources of particular interest or importance to CIROH, NOAA, and/or the U.S. National Weather Service. The resources listed in this collection are scanned and made available for rapid discovery through the CIROH Science Portal at https://portal.ciroh.org/.
